The earlier answer stands. The team note is wrong: Elif can't go first, because Ben must come before Finn and Finn is right after Elif. Since Hana is right after Ben, Ben, Hana and then Elif must follow in that order.

1. Elif, Finn and Gus are consecutive, in that order. Ben and Hana are consecutive, and so are Ann and Ivo.
2. Ben is before Finn and Elif is directly before Finn, so Ben is before Elif. Hana sits right after Ben, so Hana is also before Elif.
3. Cara is before Dev and Dev is before Ben, so the start is Cara, Dev, Ben, Hana.
4. Ann is after Elif, and Ivo is right after Ann and after Gus. Ann can't fall inside the Elif–Finn–Gus block, so Ann and Ivo come after Gus.
5. That order uses all nine people and is the only one that fits.

Hana is in slot 4 and Ivo in slot 9, five apart, which is at least three. All the other constraints hold by construction.

CONFIDENCE: 99
